content.description: Decentraland is a decentralized metaverse built on Ethereum where users can explore, create, experience, and monetize their own content and applications. The virtual world has a finite 3D space called LAND, divided into parcels and represented by non-fungible tokens (NFTs). Land parcels can be purchased with MANA, the ecosystem’s native token, with ownership tracked by NFT records. Founded in 2017, Decentraland gives users full control over their virtual environments and the experiences they build.
